title: A Red Balloon Is Tied To My Window (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you wake up and there's a red balloon tied to your window.
On the string, there's a little card. "Happy birthday."
You think it's a cute mistake. You leave it there.
The next morning, there are two balloons.
The morning after, three. Then four.
Your neighbours start taking photos. Your mum thinks you have a secret admirer.
By Friday, there are twenty balloons. Your whole window is red.
You can't see outside anymore. Your room glows red all day.
That night, you hear something tapping on the glass.
Squeak. Squeak. Like someone rubbing a balloon.
The balloons are all facing you. Every single one has a smiley face drawn on it.
And they're all slowly turning, like heads.
*Then one of them pops. And behind it, there's an eye. Looking straight at you.
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
